task.description:
WF-03 Step 5a — BACKEND-DEV fix compile error in iss0123_regression_test.zig.

The test-integration-iss0123 build failed with a compile error:
- tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig lines 106 and 154 use std.fs.cwd() which was removed in Zig 0.16
- Replacement: std.Io.Dir.cwd()

Required actions:
1. Read tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig lines 100-160 to see the exact context.
2. Replace std.fs.cwd() with std.Io.Dir.cwd() at the two lines. Also check if there are any other std.fs calls that need the Zig 0.16 update.
3. Verify: zig build test-integration-iss0123 exits 0 (test compiles).
4. Run the test: zig build test-integration-iss0123 and capture the result.
5. Commit and push:
   - git add -A
   - git commit -m "fix(ISS-0123): update iss0123_regression_test to Zig 0.16 std.Io.Dir API (GH #389)"
   - git push origin feature/WF03-gh389-20260802

When done:
- Set handoff status: "COMPLETED"
- Fill result.status: "PASS", result.summary: "Fixed std.fs.cwd() → std.Io.Dir.cwd() in iss0123 test", result.artifacts_out: ["tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig"], result.issues: [], result.next_action: "Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 5b) — re-run iss0123 test"
- Set completed_at to current ISO8601 timestamp
- Update handoffs/registry.json for the new handoff_id
- Append to handoffs/orchestrator.log
- IMPORTANT: registry.json must use open(..., encoding='utf-8'). Use \n (not CRLF).

Allowed commands: zig build, replace_string_in_file, git, ripgrep. NO git push --force, NO git push to main, NO rm -rf.
acceptance_criteria: No other std.fs.cwd() references remain in the file
Test PASSES (or skips cleanly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is unset)
Changes committed and pushed to feature/WF03-gh389-20260802

result.summary: Fixed std.fs.cwd() ? std.Io.Dir.cwd() in iss0123 test; test now compiles and PASSES
